1.1: Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash, bevet avtinas, uvevet hannitzotz, uvevet hammoked. vehaleviyyim beesrim veechad makom. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. arbaa, al arba pinnotav mittocho. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare haazara. arbaa, al arba pinnoteha mibbachutz. veechad belishkat hakkarban, veechad belishkat happarochet, veechad laachore vet hakkapporet:
1.2: Ish har habbayit haya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar, vaavukot dolkin lefanav, vechol mishmar sheeno omed, omer lo ish har habbayit, shalom alecha. nikkar shehu yashen, chovto vemaklo. ureshut haya lo lisrof et kesuto. vehem omrim, ma kol baazara. kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin, sheyyashen lo al mishmaro. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, paam achat matzu et achi imma yashen, vesarfu et kesuto:
1.3: Chamishsha shearim hayu lehar habbayit. shene shaare chulda min haddarom, meshammeshin kenisa vitzia. kifonos min hammaarav, meshammesh kenisa vitzia. tadi min hatztzafon, lo haya meshammesh kelum. shaar hammizrachi, alav shushan habbira tzura, shebbo chohen gadol hassoref et happara ufara vechol mesaadeha yotzim lehar hammishcha:
1.4: Shiva shearim hayu vaazara, shelosha vatztzafon ushelosha vaddarom veechad bammizrach. shebbaddarom, shaar haddelek. sheni lo, shaar habbechorot. shelishi lo, shaar hammayim. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor, ushete leshachot hayu lo, achat mimino veachat missemolo, achat lishkat pinchas hammalbish, veachat lishkat ose chavittin:
1.5: Veshebbatztzafon, shaar hannitzotz. uchemin achsadra haya, vaaliyya venuya al gabbav, shehakkohanim shomrim milmalan vehaleviyyim millemattan, ufetach haya lo lachel. sheni lo, shaar hakkarban. shelishi lo, bet hammoked:
1.6: Vearba leshachot hayu bevet hammoked, kekitonot petuchot litraklin, shetayim bakkodesh ushetayim bachol, verashe fispasin mavdilin ben kodesh lachol. ume hayu meshammeshot. maaravit deromit, hi hayta lishkat telae karban. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat ose lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit, bah ganzu vene chashmonay et avne hammizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan. tzefonit maaravit, bah yordim levet hattevila:
1.7: Shenayim shearim hayu levet hammoked, echad patuach lachel veechad patuach laazara. amar rabbi yehuda, ze shehaya fatuach laazara, pishpash katan haya lo, shebbo nichnasin livlosh et haazara:
1.8: Bet hammoked, kippa, uvayit gadol haya, mukkaf rovadin shel even, vezikne vet av yeshenim sham, umaftechot haazara beyadam, ufirche chehunna, ish kisto vaaretz:
1.9: Umakom haya sham, amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, veshalshelet shehammaftechot hayu teluyot bah. higgia zeman hanneila, higbiah et hattavla battabbaat venatal et hammaftechot min hashshalshelet, venaal hakkohen mibbifnim, uven levi yashen lo mibbachutz. gamar millinol, hechezir et hammaftechot lashshalshelet veet hattavla limkomah, natan kesuto aleha, yashen lo. era keri beachad mehem, yotze veholech lo vammesibba haholechet tachat habbira, vehannerot dolkim mikkan umikkan, ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bammesibba haholechet tachat hachel yotze veholech lo betadi:

2.1: Har habbayit haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma, rubbo min haddarom, sheni lo min hammizrach, shelishi lo min hatztzafon, miuto min hammaarav. mekom shehaya rov middato, sham haya rov tashmisho:
2.2: Kol hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veyotzin derech semol, chutz mimmi sheero davar, shehu makkif lismol. ma lecha makkif lismol, sheani avel, hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachamekka. sheani menudde, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbam vikarvucha, divre rabbi meir. amar lo rabbi yose, asitan keillu avru alav et haddin. ella, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbecha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha:
2.3: Lifnim mimmennu, soreg, gavoah asara tefachim. ushelosh esre feratzot hayu sham, shepperatzum malche yavan. chazru ugedarum, vegazru chenegdam shelosh esre hishtachavayot. lifnim mimmennu, hachel, eser ammot. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham. rum hammaala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma. kol hammaalot shehayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim vehashshearim shehayu sham, gavhan esrim amma, verachban eser ammot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim shehayu sham, hayu lahen delatot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, hayu lahen shekofot, chutz mishshaar tadi, shehayu sham shete avanim muttot zo al gav zo. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, nishtannu lihyot shel zahav, chutz mishshaar nikkanor, mippene shennaasa vahen nes. veyesh omrim, mippene shennechushtan matzhiv:
2.4: Kol hakketalim shehayu sham, hayu gevohim, chutz mikkotel hammizrachi, shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed berosh har hammishcha, umitkavven veroe vefitcho shel hechol bishat hazzayat haddam:
2.5: Ezrat hannashim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. vearba leshachot hayu vearba miktzooteha, shel arbaim arbaim amma. velo hayu mekorot. vechach hem atidim lihyot, shenneemar (yechezkel 46), vayyotzieni el hechatzer hachitzona vayyaavireni el arbaat miktzoe hechatzer vehinne chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, bearbaat miktzoot hechatzer chatzerot keturot. veen keturot ella sheenan mekorot. ume hayu meshammeshot. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat hannezirim, sheshsham hannezirim mevashshelin et shalmehen, umegallechin et searan, umeshallechim tachat haddud. mizrachit tzefonit, hi hayta lishkat haetzim, sheshsham hakkohanim baale mumin matliin haetzim. vechol etz shennimtza vo tolaat, pasul meal gabbe hammizbeach. tzefonit maaravit, hi hayta lishkat metzoraim. maaravit deromit, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, sham hayu notnin yayin vashemen, hi hayta nikret lishkat bet shemanya. vachalaka hayta barishona, vehikkifuha chetzotzra, shehannashim root milmalan, vehaanashim millemattan, kede shello yehu meoravin. vachamesh esre maalot olot mittochah leezrat yisrael, keneged chamesh esre maalot shebbattehillim, shealehen haleviyyim omrim bashshir. lo hayu terutot, ella mukkafot kachatzi goren agulla:
2.6: Uleshachot hayu tachat ezrat yisrael, ufetuchot leezrat hannashim, sheshsham haleviyyim notnim kinnorot unevalim umetziltayim vechol kele shir. ezrat yisrael hayta orech mea amma usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. vechen ezrat kohanim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. verashe fispasin mavdilin ben ezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, maala hayta sham, ugevoha amma, vehadduchan natun aleha, uvah shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma. nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha meezrat yisrael shete ammot umechetza. kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. ushelosh esre hishtachavayot hayu sham. abba yose ven chanan omer, keneged shelosha asar shearim. shearim deromiyyim semuchim lammaarav, shaar haelyon, shaar haddelek, shaar habbechorot, shaar hammayim, velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim. shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch bechag. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, uvo hammayim mefakkim, vaatidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. uleummatan batztzafon semuchim lammaarav, shaar yechanya, shaar hakkarban, shaar hannashim, shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya, shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor. ushene fishpashim hayu lo, echad mimino veechad missemolo. ushenayim bamaarav, lo haya lahem shem:

3.1: Hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim. ala amma vechanas amma, ze hayesod. nimtza sheloshim al sheloshim. ala chamesh vechanas amma. ze hassovev. nimtza esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. mekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vashesh al esrim vashesh. mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim, amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vearba al esrim vearba, mekom hammaaracha. amar rabbi yose, mittechilla lo haya ella shemone veesrim al shemone veesrim, kones veole bemidda zo, ad shennimtza mekom hammaaracha esrim al esrim. ucheshealu vene haggola, hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav, kemin gamma, shenneemar (yechezkel mag), vehaariel shetem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua. yachol sheeno ella shetem esre al shetem esre, keshehu omer (sham) el arbaat revaav, melammed shemmin haemtza hu moded shetem esre amma lechol ruach. vechut shel sikra chogro vaemtza, lehavedil ben haddamim haelyonim laddamim hattachtonim. vehayesod haya mehallech al pene chol hatztzafon veal pene chol hammaarav, veochel baddarom amma achat, uvammizrach amma echat:
3.2: Uvekeren maaravit deromit hayu shene nekavim, kemin shene chotamin dakkin, shehaddamim hannittanin al yesod maaravi veal yesod deromi, yordin bahen umitarvin baamma, veyotzin lenachal kidron:
3.3: Lematta varitzfa beotah hakkeren, makom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, shebbo yordin lashshit umenakkin oto. vechevesh haya lidromo shel mizbeach, sheloshim ushetayim al rochav shesh esre, urevuva hayta lo bemaaravo, sheshsham hayu notnim pesule chattat haof:
3.4: Echad avne hakkevesh veechad avne hammizbeach, mibbikat bet karem. vechofrin lematta mehabbetula, umeviim mishsham avanim shelemot, shello hunaf alehen barzel, shehabbarzel posel bingia. uvifgima lechol davar. nifgema achat mehen, hi fesula vechullan kesherot. umelabbenim otan paamayim bashshana, achat bappesach veachat bechag. vehahechol, paam achat, bappesach. rabbi omer, kol erev shabbat melabbenim oto vemappa mippene haddamim. lo hayu sadin otan bechafis shel barzel, shemma yigga veyifsol, shehabbarzel nivra lekatztzer yamav shel adam, vehammizbeach nivra lehaarich yamav shel adam, eno vadin sheyyunaf hamekatztzer al hammaarich:
3.5: Vetabbaot hayu litzfono shel mizbeach, shishsha sedarim shel arba arba, veyesh omrim, arbaa shel shesh shesh, shealehen shochatin et hakkodashim. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasin, ureviin shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahem, ushelosha sedarim hayu lechol echad veechad, shebbahem tolin. umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:
3.6: Hakkiyyor haya ben haulam velammizbeach, umashuch kelappe haddarom. ben haulam velammizbeach, esrim ushetayim amma. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah amma. amma amma veroved shalosh, veamma amma veroved shalosh. vehaelyona, amma amma veroved arba. rabbi yehuda omer, haelyona, amma amma veroved chamesh:
3.7: Pitcho shel ulam, gavho arbaim amma, verachbo esrim amma. vechamesh malteraot shel milat hayu al gabbav. hattachtona odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze. shellemala mimmenna odefet aleha amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtzet haelyona sheloshim amma. venidbach shel avanim haya ven kol achat veechat:
3.8: Uchelonasot shel erez hayu kevuin mikkatlo shel hechol lechatlo shel ulam, kede shello yivat. vesharsherot shel zahav hayu kevuot betikrat haulam, shebbahen pirche chehunna olin veroin et haatarot, shenneemar (zecharya 6), vehaatarot tihye lechelem uletoviyya velidaya ulechen ben tzefanya lezikkaron behechal Adonai. gefen shel zahav hayta omedet al pitcho shel hechol, umudla al gabbe chelonasot. kol mi shehu mitnaddev ale, o gargir, o eshkol, mevi vetole vah. amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, maase haya, venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim:

4.1: Pitcho shel hechol, gavho esrim amma verachbo eser ammot. vearba delatot hayu lo, shetayim bifnim ushetayim bachutz, sheneemar (yechezkel ma), ushetayim delatot lahechol velakkodesh. hachitzonot niftachot letoch happetach lechassot avyo shel kotel, vehappenimiyyot niftachot letoch habbayit lechassot achar haddelatot, shekkol habbayit tuach bezahav, chutz meachar haddelatot. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch happetach hayu omdot, uchemin itzteramita hayu, venikpalot laachorehen, ellu shete ammot umechetza, veellu shete ammot umechetza, chatzi amma mezuza mikkan, vachatzi amma mezuza mikkan, shenneemar (sham), ushetayim delatot laddelatot shetayim musabbot delatot, shetayim ledelet echat ushete delatot laacheret:
4.2: Ushene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad batztzafon, veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom, lo nichnas bo adam meolam, vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel, shenneemar (sham 44), vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur. natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas lehatta, umehatta lahechol. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch avyo shel kotel haya mehallech, ad shennimtza omed ben shene hashshearim, ufatach et hachitzonot mibbifnim veet happenimiyyot mibbachutz:
4.3: Usheloshim ushemona taim hayu sham, chamishsha asar batztzafon, chamishsha asar baddarom, ushemona bammaarav. shebbatztzafon veshebbaddarom, chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha, vachamishsha al gabbehem. veshebbammaarav, shelosha al gabbe shelosha, ushenayim al gabbehem. ushelosha fetachim hayu lechol echad veechad, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta min hassemol, veechad latta sheal gabbav. uvekeren mizrachit tzefonit hayu chamishsha fetachim, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta sheal gabbav, veechad lammesibba, veechad lappishpash, veechad lahechol:
4.4: Hattachtona, chamesh, veroved shesh. vehaemtzait, shesh, veroved sheva. vehaelyona, sheva, shenneemar (Melachim 1 6), hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rachbah vehattichona shesh baamma rachbah vehashshelishit sheva baamma rachba:
4.5: Umesibba hayta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit, shebbah hayu olim legaggot hattaim. haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav. halach al kol pene hatztzafon, ad shehu maggia lammaarav. higgia lammaarav, vehafach panav laddarom. halach kol pene maarav ad shehu maggia laddarom. higgia laddarom, vehafach panav lammizrach. haya mehallech baddarom, ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya, sheppitchah shel aliyya patuach laddarom. uvefitchah shel aliyya hayu shene chelonasot shel erez, shebbahen hayu olin legaggah shel aliyya. verashe fispasin mavdilim baaliyya ben hakkodesh leven kodesh hakkodashim. velulin hayu fetuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkodashim, shebbahen hayu meshalshelin et haummanim betevot, kede shello yazunu enehen mibbet kadshe hakkodashim:
4.6: Vehahechol mea al mea, al rum mea. haotem shesh ammot, vegavho arbaim amma, amma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, vegova shel aliyya arbaim amma, veamma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, veshalosh ammot maake, veamma kale orev, rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya chale orev ole min hammidda, ella arba ammot haya maake:
4.7: Mehammizrach lammaarav mea amma, kotel haulam chamesh, vehaulam achad asar, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho arbaim amma, amma teraksin, veesrim amma bet kodesh hakkodashim, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh. min hatztzafon laddarom shivim amma, kotel hammesibba chamesh, vehammesibba shalosh, kotel hatta chamesh, vehatta shesh, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho esrim amma, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh, uvet horadat hammayim shalosh ammot, vehakkotel chamesh ammot. haulam odef alav chamesh esre amma min hatztzafon, vachamesh esre amma min haddarom, vehu haya nikra bet hachalifot, sheshsham gonzim et hassakkinim. vehahechol tzar meacharav, verachav millefanav, vedome laari, shenneemar (yeshaya 29), hoy ariel ariel kiryat chana david, ma haari tzar meacharav verachav millefanav, af hahechol tzar meacharav verachav millefanav:

5.1: Kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. min hammizrach lammaarav mea ushemonim vasheva, mekom derisat yisrael achat esre amma, mekom derisat hakkohanim achat esre amma, hammizbeach sheloshim ushetayim, ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushetayim amma, hahechol mea amma, veachat esre amma laachore vet hakkapporet:
5.2: Min hatztzafon laddarom mea usheloshim vechamesh, hakkevesh vehammizbeach shishshim ushetayim. min hammizbeach lattabbaot shemone ammot, mekom hattabbaot esrim vearba, min hattabbaot lashshulchanot arba, min hashshulchanot velannannasin arba. min hannannasin lechotel haazara shemone ammot, vehammotar ben hakkevesh lakkotel umekom hannannasin:
5.3: Shesh leshachot hayu vaazara, shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom. shebbatztzafon, lishkat hammelach, lishkat happarva, lishkat hamedichim. lishkat hammelach, sham hayu notnim melach lakkarban. lishkat happarva, sham hayu molchin orot kadashim, veal gaggah haya vet hattevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hamedichin, sheshsham hayu medichin kirve hakkodashim. umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva:
5.4: Shebbaddarom, lishkat haetz, lishkat haggola, lishkat haggazit. lishkat haetz, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, lishkat kohen gadol, vehi hayta achore shetehen, vegag shelashtan shave. lishkat haggola, sham haya vor kavua, vehaggalgal natun alav, umishsham maspikim mayim lechol haazara. lishkat haggazit, sham hayta sanhedri gedola shel yisrael yoshevet vedana et hakkehunna, vechohen shennimtza vo fesul, lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim, veyotze veholech lo. veshello nimtza vo fesul, lovesh levanim umitattef levanim, nichnas umeshammesh im echav hakkohanim. veyom tov hayu osim, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon hakkohen, vechach hayu omrim, baruch hammakom baruch hu, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon. uvaruch hu, shebbachar beaharon uvevanav laamod lesharet lifne Adonai bevet kadshe hakkodashim:
